title: RAID EVENTS: COOLANT RUPTURE
why: The fourth raid event, the coolant rupture: a district fogs over. An 18 second warning shows a wide ring and a countdown, then for 75 seconds that district is a white cloud with three effects. You see less inside it, down to under half as far at the middle, fading back to normal toward the rim (the machines see as they always did). Cryo rounds from the Forge build cold twice as fast on anything inside, so a freeze comes in half the hits. And every crate, locker, safe and cache in the district that is still shut holds one more item, shown by a pale glint. When it ends everything goes back. DEMO and CAREER work the same.
now: The coolant rupture event fogs a district: shorter view, double cryo and richer crates inside.
